architectural_units.name: User
architectural_units.description: The client is the user of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for displaying information to the user.

architectural_units.name: Business Layer
architectural_units.description: This layer is the core of the application and is responsible for processing all the information.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for storing all the data.

architectural_units.name: Web Platform
architectural_units.description: In the case of this layer, it can be observed that it is formed by the web platform interface and the Waapiti mobile platform.

architectural_units.name: Mobile Platform
architectural_units.description: In the case of this layer, it can be observed that it is formed by the web platform interface and the Waapiti mobile platform.

architectural_units.name: API Gateway
architectural_units.description: The only component that interacts directly with the presentation layer is the Api Gateway module.

architectural_units.name: Core
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for performing the business logic of the platform, it would be the main core of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Analytical Module
architectural_units.description: The analytical module has as its main function to obtain and process the data of the playlogs, the connections and the actions in the platform.

architectural_units.name: API Player
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for communicating with the players by receiving all the information corresponding to it.

architectural_units.name: Web Socket
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for carrying out the communication between the platform and the players, and in this way allows the exchange of information between them.

architectural_units.name: Database Service
architectural_units.description: The database used is a MySQL database that is responsible for storing all the data necessary for the operation of the system.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: The database used is a MySQL database.

architectural_units.name: AWS RDS
architectural_units.description: This database is implemented in the RDS service, which is a distributed relational database service from AWS.

architectural_units.name: Data Lake Service
architectural_units.description: The objective of these services is to form a data lake where all the history is stored to be able to process them in the analytical module.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: This is the object storage service of AWS.

architectural_units.name: DynamoDB
architectural_units.description: This service is a non-relational database of AWS.

architectural_units.name: NestJS
architectural_units.description: As a framework, NestJS will be used.

architectural_units.name: TypeScript
architectural_units.description: With the Typescript language.

architectural_units.name: AWS
architectural_units.description: For the infrastructure, the cloud services of AWS will be used.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: The communication between the two components is carried out through the internet using the HTTP protocol.

architectural_units.name: REST API
architectural_units.description: The communication between the two components is carried out through the internet using the REST API model.

architectural_units.name: TCP
architectural_units.description: The communication between the Api Gateway service is through the TCP communication protocol.

architectural_units.name: Amazon Athena
architectural_units.description: The Amazon Athena service is a service that allows SQL queries to be performed on data stored in Amazon S3.

architectural_units.name: AWS Glue
architectural_units.description: The AWS Glue service is a serverless data integration service.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Streams
architectural_units.description: Kinesis Data Streams is a data processing and ingestion service specifically aimed at data streaming.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
architectural_units.description: The Kinesis Data Firehose service has as its main function the loading of large amounts of data into data warehouses.

architectural_units.name: AWS CDK
architectural_units.description: AWS Cloud Development, also called AWS CDK, is the AWS framework that allows the construction of cloud applications.

architectural_units.name: AWS CloudFormation
architectural_units.description: AWS CloudFormation is an Amazon service that helps configure AWS resources.

architectural_units.name: Player
architectural_units.description: A player consists of a device that can be internal or external, which allows the screens to play content.
The presentation layer communicates with the business layer, more specifically with the Api Gateway, using the HTTP protocol.
The Api Gateway service processes requests to send them to the Core service and the Analytical Module.
The communication between the Api Gateway service is through the TCP communication protocol.
The Core service interacts with the database, although it also interacts to a lesser extent with cloud services.
The Analytical Module interacts with cloud services, although it also interacts to a lesser extent with the database.
The Api Player service is responsible for communicating with the players by receiving all the information corresponding to it. [...] This information is processed and stored.

The Web Socket service is responsible for carrying out the communication between the platform and the players, and in this way allows the exchange of information between them. [...] It processes the data coming from the players and stores them in the database and in the cloud services.
The Analytical Module uses the Amazon Athena service to perform queries on data stored in Amazon S3.
The AWS Glue service works in conjunction with Athena so that it can read data from S3 correctly.

Kinesis Data Streams reads data from different generators (Producers) and sends them to the consumers (Consumers). [...] In the case of the playlogs the generator is the WebSocket microservice [...] while the audit trail has as generator the Core.
For the consumers we have the Kinesis Data Firehose service, which is responsible for saving the data in the S3.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: En el nostre projecte la plataforma de Waapiti és un servei web que segueix l’arquitectura client-servidor.

patterns.name: Three Layers
patterns.description: Pel model client-servidor s’utilitza l’arquitectura de 3 capes, on el sistema es devidiex en 3 capes, la capa de presentació, la capa de negoci i la capa de dades.

patterns.name: API Gateway
patterns.description: Això és degut de què es segueix el patró de disseny de microserveis Api Gateway.

patterns.name: Microservices
patterns.description: En el cas de la plataforma de Waapiti, l’arquitectura física no es correspon exactament a l’arquitectura lògica, ja que tant la capa de negoci com la capa de dades es divideixen en diversos serveis diferents.
